backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a contact form backend with CRUD operations (create, getAllForms, getAllFormsByEmail, delete) using a Map to store form submissions with auto-incrementing IDs.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summary document listing all frontend files with brief descriptions of their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, defining design tokens for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React application from /src/main.tsx with basic meta tags and title 'ankur.net.in'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the Home page with QueryClientProvider for React Query integration.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section component displaying four feature cards (Technical Excellence, Innovation, Fast Delivery, Client Focused) and a mission statement card.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Contact form component with name, email, and message inputs, form validation, submission handling via useContactForm hook, and success/error message display.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with brand logo, quick navigation links, contact info, copyright notice, and Caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation menus, smooth scroll functionality, and responsive mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image overlay, centered logo, headline with 'Ankur' branding, tagline, and call-to-action button that scrolls to contact form.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook for contact form submission that validates email format, calls the backend actor's createForm method, and manages submission state and errors using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Comprehensive Internet Identity authentication provider and hook that manages AuthClient lifecycle, identity state, login/logout flows, and provides authentication status throughout the React component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching contact form data: useGetAllForms retrieves all forms and useGetAllFormsByEmail retrieves forms filtered by email, both dependent on the actor being available.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens defining a warm, earthy color palette with teal and amber accents, supporting both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that composes the main landing page layout with Header, Hero, About, ContactForm, and Footer components in a flex column structure.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Cal Sans), OKLCH-based color system, container settings, custom shadows, and accordion animations, plus typography and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking a web-based support chatbot ticketing system with existing features for homepage, contact form, about section, theming, ticket management, admin dashboard, and Internet Identity authentication.
